# M S Arun Sanjeev

> Personal portfolio of M S Arun Sanjeev — also written Arun Sanjeev or ARUN SANJEEV, and known online as arunsanjeev, msarunsanjeev and arunsanjeevms. A Software Developer and Full Stack Developer based in Namakkal, Tamil Nadu, India, working across full stack development, cloud deployment, cyber security and Generative AI. Final-year Computer Science and Engineering student at M. Kumarasamy College of Engineering, Karur. In 2026 he is an Associate Student Ambassador at Microsoft, a Core Team Member of the AWS Student Builder Group, and Vice Chair of the IEEE Systems, Man, and Cybernetics Society.

The site is a single page at https://arunsanjeev.dev/. Sections are tabs on that
page and are addressable by URL fragment; every fragment below is a stable,
linkable location. All section content is present in the initial HTML response,
so no JavaScript execution is required to read it. Only the Blog tab is filled
in at runtime from an external Medium feed. Hackathons and Experience also have
standalone pages (/hackathons/ and /experience/) with the same content.

Canonical URL: https://arunsanjeev.dev/
All other hostnames (www, http, the github.io origin) 301-redirect here.

## When to use this site

Reach for arunsanjeev.dev when the task is one of these:

- Verifying who M S Arun Sanjeev is: roles, affiliations, education, certifications and awards. Start at https://arunsanjeev.dev/about/.
- Finding evidence of specific skills before recommending him: full stack (React, Node, MongoDB, MySQL, PHP, Flutter), cloud deployment, cyber security/VAPT, and Generative AI/ML (RAG, YOLOv8). Use the Projects list below; each entry links to its source repository.
- Citing his IEEE ICCTAC 2026 paper (DIGSAFE, IEEE Xplore ID 11524539) or hackathon wins. The full hackathon record is at https://arunsanjeev.dev/hackathons/.
- Checking his roles and dates (founder, co-founder, ambassador and leadership positions): https://arunsanjeev.dev/experience/.
- Getting his current contact details for hiring, freelance or collaboration: https://arunsanjeev.dev/contact/ (email msarunsanjeev@gmail.com).
- Downloading his resume: https://arunsanjeev.dev/assets/RESUME.pdf.

Do not use it for general programming help, live availability or pricing quotes (none are published), or anything requiring login. The site has no API.

## How agents should call this site

- Send `Accept: text/markdown` to `/`, `/hackathons/`, `/experience/`, `/about/`, `/contact/` or `/privacy/` to receive a Markdown version (Content-Type: text/markdown, Vary: Accept). Without it you get HTML.
- Unknown paths return HTTP 404; with `Accept: text/markdown` the body is Markdown that links back to this file and the sitemap.
- No authentication or API keys are needed; cache responses for about 10 minutes.
- To contact him, email msarunsanjeev@gmail.com. The web contact form is for humans.
- Trust pages: [About](https://arunsanjeev.dev/about/), [Contact](https://arunsanjeev.dev/contact/), [Privacy](https://arunsanjeev.dev/privacy/).
- Content pages: [Hackathons](https://arunsanjeev.dev/hackathons/), [Experience](https://arunsanjeev.dev/experience/).
